build_MDNRNN_model: build a Mixture Density Network RNN model with LSTM and GMM output layers for state prediction
run_MDNRNN_forward: run the MDNRNN forward pass to predict next state GMM parameters, reward, and non-terminal signals
create_MDNRNNMemoryPool: create a replay memory pool with deque-based storage for MDN-RNN training samples and batch sampling
test_gmm_loss: test the GMM loss function to compute negative log probability of batch data under the mixture model
review_MDNRNN_get_initial_hidden_state: review the MDNRNN get_initial_hidden_state method that returns zero-initialized LSTM hidden and cell states
